questions.prompt: Name a real named award, prize, medal or trophy.
questions.scope: Actual named awards, prizes, medals, orders and trophies across arts, sports, science and public life count, including historical awards and genuine named award families. Real named categories are answers within this one subject. A generic placing/medal, recipient, sponsor, organization, tournament, festival or hall-of-fame membership is not automatically a named award. Different awards sharing a public surname/title remain distinct and use qualifiers where needed.
questions.rationale: Two independent broad public-life subjects preserve familiar entry answers and documented rare names. Source list bodies and actual publisher calendar/name cells are reviewed by role and identity. Sponsors, recipients, dates, sidebars and unsupported labels are held. Shared dates or similar names do not establish identity. Rows expand answers, never prompts
